newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Kinkel thanks Yemen in hostage release.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel thanks Yemen in hostage release.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel on Tuesday thanked Yemeni security forces for insuring the release of seven German tourists from tribesmen who had held them hostage for a week.
"The Yemeni side granted this difficult kidnapping case the highest attention," Kinkel said in a statement after Yemeni security forces ushered the Germans onto a plane to Sanaa, the Yemeni capital.
Kinkel also noted the role of officials in the Yemeni foreign and defense ministries and in province capital Mukallah in securing the captives' release. The seven were reported in good health.
The seven men aged between 30 and 45 were abducted last week while riding motorcycles through the Wadi al-Dabaat area between Mahra and Hadramaut provinces.
